dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good morning, Elaine. Adrian Lim here from the private banking team. Have I caught you at a convenient time for our scheduled call? I'll keep it brief, as I know your work mornings can be quite packed.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Morning, Adrian. Yes, I've stepped into a quiet room. I've got a little time before the next meeting, so we can cover what we need now.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. Before we get into the main part, could you provide your identification particulars for our verification?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: My FIN is G seven nine nine nine three zero six E. My date of birth is 7 February 1984.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Elaine. That's the verification portion completed. I'll leave you to set out what you wanted to discuss today.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The holding I want to reduce is Orion Global Income Fund. I was considering a reduction of 700 units. I've got my notes beside me, so no need to wait while I look for anything.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Let me cover the relevant disclosure first. For Orion Global Income Fund, rising market interest rates can push down the value of the bonds it holds, which can also lower its unit value. Do you understand how rising interest rates can lower the fund's unit value?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. If interest rates rise, the bonds can fall in value and bring the fund's unit value down.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: The transaction charge is 0.25% of the sale proceeds. You could lose some or all of the capital you invested in this fund, and selling may realise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a loss realised when reducing this holding?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, including a realised loss on this reduction.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. You mentioned previously that your work routine had changed. Are you mainly working from the consultancy's office now, or still moving between home and the office?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Mostly the office now. We've brought the project meetings together rather than spreading them across the week. My sister handles the morning staff catch-ups, and I come in a bit later. It makes the day less fragmented.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That sounds more manageable for your diary. For future contact, would you still prefer a telephone call rather than arranging a branch visit? We can work around your office meetings.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, telephone is still easiest. Getting to the branch takes a chunk out of the day, and I prefer a concise conversation. Anyway, back to my notes. I want to sell, not add to the holding. Use Singapore dollars as the transaction currency. Set the transaction amount at 150,000. For the order quantity, use the number of units I mentioned earlier. Place it as a limit order, with the limit price at 214.3 Singapore dollars.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Please confirm your final instruction: sell 700 units of Orion Global Income Fund, with a transaction amount of 150,000 in Singapore dollars, using a limit order at a limit price of 214.3 Singapore dollars. Is that the instruction you want me to execute?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction exactly as you have stated it. Please proceed.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Elaine. I'll keep the usual correspondence in the secure channel. If we need to reach you for any administrative follow-up, is your mobile still the best way?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, use my mobile. If I'm in a meeting, leave a brief message and I'll call back. Please don't route routine calls through the office reception.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Noted. We'll use your direct contact route. That's all I need for this call; I won't keep you from your next meeting. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, Adrian. This timing worked well. Have a good day, and I'll watch for the correspondence. Bye.
